step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to obtain the information.
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 4.
If the client was not contacted and the additional information was not obtained, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “disputed itemized statement of benefits paid.”

Details: Type “Client is disputing itemized statement of benefits paid.” Document any additional information. Refer to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
